description: This file defines the mantisrestInterface class, which integrates with the Mantis bug tracking system via REST API. It includes methods for connecting, retrieving issues, checking issue status, and managing links between issues.

classes.name: mantisrestInterface
classes.description: A class that interfaces with the Mantis bug tracker via REST API, providing methods for issue retrieval, status checking, and link management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets configuration, and establishes connection to Mantis.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and normalizes configuration parameters for the API connection.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the bug ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the Mantis bug tracking system using API credentials.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Mantis is active.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs URL to view a specific bug in Mantis.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific issue from Mantis.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status string of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string of the issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with the given ID exists in Mantis.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Creates a link between issues in Mantis.

methods.name: removeLink
methods.description: Removes a link between issues in Mantis.

methods.name: addExecLink
methods.description: Adds an execution link related to a test case in Mantis.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuration parameters.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API (returns true).
